operation: FP32 vocabulary softmax, one token, full output; synthetic dynamic logits; no model tokens/s claim
production: Each SM computes fixed strided logits. Even SM producers publish 8-byte logsumexp state at fixed producer-owned mailbox; odd consumers assigned by map merge once. Last consumer reduces 28 states and publishes global norm; all SMs output probabilities. No synthetic repeat loop in operator.
mechanism: Only odd-SM consumer permutation changes. Producer SMs, input work, mailbox addresses and total work unchanged; all CTA initialization/barrier, polls, launch and reset included.
calibration: Two training and two validation processes, 28x28 directed pairs x3 actual aligned mailbox offsets, 2 rounds, 128+16 warm round trips, 8-byte payload. Independent from real-operator timings. Isolated RTT is proxy, not exact one-way latency.
fit: Minimax from training cycles with minsum tie break. WORST maximizes total isolated cost. Map fixed before holdout operator; no end-to-end map selection.
baselines: native two-pass full-GPU softmax with matching math precision
same cooperative paired kernel with IDENTITY and RANDOM
stats: Paired log ratios of block medians; per process aggregate, six-process bootstrap; case/offset all retained.
claim: Net gain over fastest development selected ordinary baseline plus SAME_KERNEL_IDENTITY and RANDOM; lower95CI>0 overall, corrected98.75percase. No fake success from general fusion or launch reduction.
